contextFields.name: Analysis team
contextFields.description: Team whose perspective is used for Our/Opponent and coaching grades.

contextFields.name: Player / goalie
contextFields.description: Name or jersey number; leave unset when unknown.

contextFields.name: Recording coverage
contextFields.description: Complete tracking only when all relevant opportunities were coded; selective clips do not support success rates.

contextFields.name: Linked play ID
contextFields.description: Use the same ID for observations of the same play. Do not count a shot, save and block as separate attempts.

contextFields.name: Infraction
contextFields.description: Use the competition rule terminology; no assumed duration.

contextFields.name: Assessed duration
contextFields.description: As assessed (for example 2 min, 5 min, misconduct).

contextFields.name: Penalty drawn by
contextFields.description: Only identify a player when attribution is supported.

trackingPresets.label: Pass Attempted
trackingPresets.definition: Manual count of pass attempted. Record all relevant opportunities before using rates; do not add manual counts to derived Record totals.

trackingPresets.label: Pass / Completed
trackingPresets.definition: Intended teammate gains control from the pass, including bank, area and lead passes. Timestamp release.

trackingPresets.label: Pass Received
trackingPresets.definition: Manual count of pass received. Record all relevant opportunities before using rates; do not add manual counts to derived Record totals.

trackingPresets.label: Shot Attempt
trackingPresets.definition: Manual count of shot attempt. Record all relevant opportunities before using rates; do not add manual counts to derived Record totals.

trackingPresets.label: Shots on target (including goals)
trackingPresets.definition: Count each on-target attempt once, including goals. Do not also add the Goal counter to this aggregate.

trackingPresets.label: Shot / Goal
trackingPresets.definition: Awarded goal. Timestamp the scoring shot release; attribute the shooting team. A disallowed goal must be corrected. Grade assesses execution, not the score.

trackingPresets.label: Puck Touch
trackingPresets.definition: Manual count of puck touch. Record all relevant opportunities before using rates; do not add manual counts to derived Record totals.

trackingPresets.label: Battle / Won
trackingPresets.definition: Our analysis team establishes controlled possession from a genuine puck contest. Timestamp resolution; touching the puck alone is not control.

trackingPresets.label: Battle / Lost
trackingPresets.definition: The opponent establishes controlled possession from a genuine puck contest. Timestamp resolution; this does not assign blame to an individual.

trackingPresets.label: Possession losses (all causes)
trackingPresets.definition: Count each possession-change incident once across passes, carries and battles. Do not sum this aggregate with its causes.

trackingPresets.label: Defense / Takeaway
trackingPresets.definition: Directly dispossess an opponent who controlled the puck. Excludes pass interception and uncontested recovery. Link the same possession-change incident.

trackingPresets.label: Defense / Interception
trackingPresets.definition: Gain controlled possession by intercepting an intended opponent pass. A deflection without control is not an interception.

trackingPresets.label: Zone Entry
trackingPresets.definition: Manual count of zone entry. Record all relevant opportunities before using rates; do not add manual counts to derived Record totals.

trackingPresets.label: Controlled Zone Entry
trackingPresets.definition: Manual count of controlled zone entry. Record all relevant opportunities before using rates; do not add manual counts to derived Record totals.

trackingPresets.label: Zone entries / Dump-in
trackingPresets.definition: Puck crosses the blue line to enter the offensive zone by dump. Timestamp crossing; record retained possession or recovery independently.

trackingPresets.label: Zone Exit
trackingPresets.definition: Manual count of zone exit. Record all relevant opportunities before using rates; do not add manual counts to derived Record totals.

trackingPresets.label: Controlled Zone Exit
trackingPresets.definition: Manual count of controlled zone exit. Record all relevant opportunities before using rates; do not add manual counts to derived Record totals.

trackingPresets.label: Check / pressure applied
trackingPresets.definition: Manual combined count of checks or pressure actions. Not an inference of possession gained or good execution.

trackingPresets.label: Defense / Shot block
trackingPresets.definition: Defending skater blocks a shot attempt. Excludes blocked passes. Link to the originating shot; timestamp contact.

trackingPresets.label: Faceoffs / Won
trackingPresets.definition: Our team establishes controlled possession following the draw. Timestamp control; this is team outcome, not individual center credit.

trackingPresets.label: Faceoffs / Lost
trackingPresets.definition: Opponent establishes controlled possession following the draw. Timestamp control; do not infer individual blame.

trackingPresets.label: Time with Puck
trackingPresets.definition: Manual duration of time with puck. Record all relevant opportunities before using rates; do not add manual counts to derived Record totals.

trackingPresets.label: Shift Time
trackingPresets.definition: Manual duration of shift time. Record all relevant opportunities before using rates; do not add manual counts to derived Record totals.

trackingPresets.label: Time Moving
trackingPresets.definition: Manual duration of time moving. Record all relevant opportunities before using rates; do not add manual counts to derived Record totals.

trackingPresets.label: Time Stationary
trackingPresets.definition: Manual duration of time stationary. Record all relevant opportunities before using rates; do not add manual counts to derived Record totals.

trackingPresets.label: Time in Offensive Zone
trackingPresets.definition: Manual duration of time in offensive zone. Record all relevant opportunities before using rates; do not add manual counts to derived Record totals.

trackingPresets.label: Time in Defensive Zone
trackingPresets.definition: Manual duration of time in defensive zone. Record all relevant opportunities before using rates; do not add manual counts to derived Record totals.

trackingPresets.label: Time Pressuring Puck Carrier
trackingPresets.definition: Manual duration of time pressuring puck carrier. Record all relevant opportunities before using rates; do not add manual counts to derived Record totals.

trackingPresets.label: Time Defending Slot
trackingPresets.definition: Manual duration of time defending slot. Record all relevant opportunities before using rates; do not add manual counts to derived Record totals.

trackingPresets.label: Time in Puck Battle
trackingPresets.definition: Manual duration of time in puck battle. Record all relevant opportunities before using rates; do not add manual counts to derived Record totals.

trackingPresets.label: Shot / Blocked
trackingPresets.definition: Shot attempt prevented from reaching the net by a defending skater. Link a defensive Shot block to this attempt; timestamp release.

trackingPresets.label: Shot / Saved
trackingPresets.definition: On-target shot stopped by the goalie, without a goal. Excludes goals and defensive shot blocks. Timestamp release.

trackingPresets.label: Shot / Missed target
trackingPresets.definition: Shot that does not enter and is not a save or defensive block; includes wide, high, post and crossbar. Timestamp release.

trackingPresets.label: Shot / Outcome unclear
trackingPresets.definition: A shot attempt is visible but its result cannot be established. Do not infer a result from the grade.

trackingPresets.label: Pass / Intercepted
trackingPresets.definition: Opponent gains control by intercepting an intended pass. Takes precedence over generic Incomplete. Timestamp release.

trackingPresets.label: Pass / Incomplete
trackingPresets.definition: Intended pass does not reach controlled teammate possession and is not an interception. Possession may remain contested or with our team.

trackingPresets.label: Pass / Outcome unclear
trackingPresets.definition: Pass attempt is visible but completion/control cannot be established.

trackingPresets.label: Battle / No possession change
trackingPresets.definition: A genuine contest ends with the original controlling team retaining control. Do not also label this as a new possession gain.

trackingPresets.label: Battle / Unclear
trackingPresets.definition: A puck contest is visible but control at its resolution cannot be established.

trackingPresets.label: Defense / Pressure
trackingPresets.definition: Reduce the puck carrier time or options through proximity and positioning. Record consequence separately; pressure need not produce a takeaway.

trackingPresets.label: Defense / Stick check
trackingPresets.definition: Use the stick to challenge the puck or restrict an option. A successful contact need not establish possession.

trackingPresets.label: Defense / Body check
trackingPresets.definition: Apply body contact to challenge an eligible opponent under the competition rules. Contact is not inherently positive; record checking rules and consequence.

trackingPresets.label: Defense / Gap control
trackingPresets.definition: Assess defender distance, angle and speed relative to the attacker at the marked moment. Specify the observed issue in context.

trackingPresets.label: Defense / Coverage
trackingPresets.definition: Assess assignment, positioning and lane protection at the marked moment. Do not infer a breakdown cause without evidence.

trackingPresets.label: Goalie / Goal Against
trackingPresets.definition: Awarded goal conceded by the observed goalie/team. Timestamp shot release. This result does not establish goalie error.

trackingPresets.label: Goalie / Save
trackingPresets.definition: The goalie prevents an on-target shot from scoring. Timestamp shot release and link the shot incident; assess rebound disposition separately.

trackingPresets.label: Goalie / Puck Play
trackingPresets.definition: Goalie handles the puck outside a save: stop a rim, pass, clear, or set the puck. Record action outcome when observed.

trackingPresets.label: Goalie / Positioning
trackingPresets.definition: Coaching observation of goalie angle, depth, set position, or recovery at the marked instant. Grade only what the view supports.

trackingPresets.label: Team Play / Breakout
trackingPresets.definition: Sequence-level observation of recovery, support and puck movement out of the defensive zone. Not an additional discrete zone-exit attempt.

trackingPresets.label: Team Play / Regroup
trackingPresets.definition: Controlled team reorganization before another attack, usually in the neutral zone. A backward pass alone is not a regroup.

trackingPresets.label: Team Play / Forecheck
trackingPresets.definition: Coaching observation of coordinated pressure on an opponent breakout. Individual pressure/takeaway records may link to the same sequence.

trackingPresets.label: Team Play / Backcheck
trackingPresets.definition: Team or player recovery pressure toward the defensive zone; assess positioning and assignment at the marked moment.

trackingPresets.label: Team Play / Cycle
trackingPresets.definition: Coordinated possession rotation in the offensive zone. A sequence observation, not a new pass count.

trackingPresets.label: Team Play / Support / outlet
trackingPresets.definition: Off-puck movement or positioning that creates a usable puck-carrier option. Note timing and lane availability.

trackingPresets.label: Team Play / Screen
trackingPresets.definition: Off-puck positioning that obstructs the goalie view. Record whether the view supports the observation.

trackingPresets.label: Team Play / Net drive
trackingPresets.definition: Off-puck route toward the net that creates space, a passing option or rebound presence. Grade decision/execution separately.

trackingPresets.label: Penalty / Our penalty
trackingPresets.definition: Penalty assessed to the analysis team. Record the assessed infraction and duration if known; do not infer either from grade.

trackingPresets.label: Penalty / Opponent penalty
trackingPresets.definition: Penalty assessed to the opponent. Do not infer which player drew it, or that it was drawn by a player.

trackingPresets.label: Penalty / Coincidental penalties
trackingPresets.definition: Linked penalties assessed to both teams on the same incident. Preserve separate assessments in linked notes/events; do not infer strength state.

trackingPresets.label: Puck possession / Recovery
trackingPresets.definition: Establish control of an available loose puck without a direct opponent dispossession. Exclude already counted battle resolutions. Timestamp control.

trackingPresets.label: Puck possession / Controlled carry
trackingPresets.definition: Move while maintaining puck control. Mark the coaching moment; do not count every stride as a new carry.

trackingPresets.label: Puck possession / Lost control
trackingPresets.definition: Lose controlled possession outside a classified pass or resolved battle. Use notes for reception/carry cause if visible.

trackingPresets.label: Zone exits / Carry-out
trackingPresets.definition: Puck crosses the blue line to leave the defensive zone by carry. Timestamp crossing; record retained possession or recovery independently.

trackingPresets.label: Zone exits / Pass-out
trackingPresets.definition: Puck crosses the blue line to leave the defensive zone by pass. Timestamp crossing; record retained possession or recovery independently.

trackingPresets.label: Zone exits / Clear-out
trackingPresets.definition: Puck crosses the blue line to leave the defensive zone by clear. Timestamp crossing; record retained possession or recovery independently.

trackingPresets.label: Zone exits / Exit denied
trackingPresets.definition: An observable attempt to leave the defensive zone ends before crossing the line. Record intended method; timestamp the denial.

trackingPresets.label: Zone entries / Carry-in
trackingPresets.definition: Puck crosses the blue line to enter the offensive zone by carry. Timestamp crossing; record retained possession or recovery independently.

trackingPresets.label: Zone entries / Pass-in
trackingPresets.definition: Puck crosses the blue line to enter the offensive zone by pass. Timestamp crossing; record retained possession or recovery independently.

trackingPresets.label: Zone entries / Entry denied
trackingPresets.definition: An observable attempt to enter the offensive zone ends before crossing the line. Record intended method; timestamp the denial.

trackingPresets.label: Faceoffs / Undetermined
trackingPresets.definition: The draw occurs but resulting team control cannot be established.

trackingPresets.label: Stoppages / Icing
trackingPresets.definition: Icing called under the competition rules. Attribute offending side if known; do not infer a pass attempt or turnover.

trackingPresets.label: Stoppages / Offside
trackingPresets.definition: Offside called under the competition rules. Link the entry attempt if known.

trackingPresets.label: Stoppages / Puck out of play
trackingPresets.definition: Play stops because the puck leaves the playing area. Do not infer delay-of-game without an assessed penalty.

trackingPresets.label: Stoppages / Puck covered / frozen
trackingPresets.definition: Play stops because the puck is covered or frozen. Link a goalie save when applicable; not an extra shot.

trackingPresets.label: Stoppages / Other whistle
trackingPresets.definition: Other observable stoppage. Describe the reason in notes; leave unknown when the footage does not establish it.

categories.name: Shot

eventTypes.name: Goal
eventTypes.definition: Awarded goal. Timestamp the scoring shot release; attribute the shooting team. A disallowed goal must be corrected. Grade assesses execution, not the score.

eventTypes.name: On Net
eventTypes.definition: Legacy on-net observation; may include goals. Do not infer a non-goal save.

eventTypes.name: Wide
eventTypes.definition: Legacy shot marked wide; high misses and posts were not explicitly distinguished.

eventTypes.name: Blocked
eventTypes.definition: Shot attempt prevented from reaching the net by a defending skater. Link a defensive Shot block to this attempt; timestamp release.

eventTypes.name: Rebound
eventTypes.definition: Legacy rebound observation; may refer to a rebound shot, rebound allowed, or recovery.

eventTypes.name: Saved
eventTypes.definition: On-target shot stopped by the goalie, without a goal. Excludes goals and defensive shot blocks. Timestamp release.

eventTypes.name: Missed target
eventTypes.definition: Shot that does not enter and is not a save or defensive block; includes wide, high, post and crossbar. Timestamp release.

eventTypes.name: Outcome unclear
eventTypes.definition: A shot attempt is visible but its result cannot be established. Do not infer a result from the grade.

categories.description: One primary outcome per shot attempt; technique and quality are separate. Timestamp release.

categories.name: Pass

eventTypes.name: Tape-to-Tape
eventTypes.definition: Legacy precise pass to a teammate stick; not a count of all completed passes.

eventTypes.name: Turnover
eventTypes.definition: Legacy possession loss attributed to a pass; mechanism unspecified.

eventTypes.name: Stretch
eventTypes.definition: Legacy long advancing pass; completion and possession outcome unspecified.

eventTypes.name: Icing
eventTypes.definition: Legacy icing observation filed under Passing; do not infer a pass attempt.

eventTypes.name: Completed
eventTypes.definition: Intended teammate gains control from the pass, including bank, area and lead passes. Timestamp release.

eventTypes.name: Intercepted
eventTypes.definition: Opponent gains control by intercepting an intended pass. Takes precedence over generic Incomplete. Timestamp release.

eventTypes.name: Incomplete
eventTypes.definition: Intended pass does not reach controlled teammate possession and is not an interception. Possession may remain contested or with our team.

eventTypes.name: Outcome unclear
eventTypes.definition: Pass attempt is visible but completion/control cannot be established.

categories.description: Classify each intended pass by outcome; method and precision are independent. Timestamp release.

categories.name: Puck possession

eventTypes.name: Recovery
eventTypes.definition: Establish control of an available loose puck without a direct opponent dispossession. Exclude already counted battle resolutions. Timestamp control.

eventTypes.name: Controlled carry
eventTypes.definition: Move while maintaining puck control. Mark the coaching moment; do not count every stride as a new carry.

eventTypes.name: Lost control
eventTypes.definition: Lose controlled possession outside a classified pass or resolved battle. Use notes for reception/carry cause if visible.

categories.description: Possession actions outside separately recorded passes and resolved battles.

categories.name: Battle

eventTypes.name: Won
eventTypes.definition: Our analysis team establishes controlled possession from a genuine puck contest. Timestamp resolution; touching the puck alone is not control.

eventTypes.name: Lost
eventTypes.definition: The opponent establishes controlled possession from a genuine puck contest. Timestamp resolution; this does not assign blame to an individual.

eventTypes.name: Hit Given
eventTypes.definition: Legacy contact applied; does not imply a battle win or good execution.

eventTypes.name: Hit Taken
eventTypes.definition: Legacy contact received; does not imply a battle loss or poor execution.

eventTypes.name: No possession change
eventTypes.definition: A genuine contest ends with the original controlling team retaining control. Do not also label this as a new possession gain.

eventTypes.name: Unclear
eventTypes.definition: A puck contest is visible but control at its resolution cannot be established.

categories.description: A genuine puck contest, resolved by team control. Contact alone is not success.

categories.name: Zone exits

eventTypes.name: Carry-out
eventTypes.definition: Puck crosses the blue line to leave the defensive zone by carry. Timestamp crossing; record retained possession or recovery independently.

eventTypes.name: Pass-out
eventTypes.definition: Puck crosses the blue line to leave the defensive zone by pass. Timestamp crossing; record retained possession or recovery independently.

eventTypes.name: Clear-out
eventTypes.definition: Puck crosses the blue line to leave the defensive zone by clear. Timestamp crossing; record retained possession or recovery independently.

eventTypes.name: Exit denied
eventTypes.definition: An observable attempt to leave the defensive zone ends before crossing the line. Record intended method; timestamp the denial.

categories.description: Attempts to leave the defensive zone. Crossing the line and retaining control are separate facts.

categories.name: Zone entries

eventTypes.name: Carry-in
eventTypes.definition: Puck crosses the blue line to enter the offensive zone by carry. Timestamp crossing; record retained possession or recovery independently.

eventTypes.name: Pass-in
eventTypes.definition: Puck crosses the blue line to enter the offensive zone by pass. Timestamp crossing; record retained possession or recovery independently.

eventTypes.name: Dump-in
eventTypes.definition: Puck crosses the blue line to enter the offensive zone by dump. Timestamp crossing; record retained possession or recovery independently.

eventTypes.name: Entry denied
eventTypes.definition: An observable attempt to enter the offensive zone ends before crossing the line. Record intended method; timestamp the denial.

categories.description: Attempts to enter the offensive zone. Count each attempt once; record retained/recovered control separately.

eventTypes.name: Giveaway

eventTypes.name: Clear

eventTypes.name: Breakdown

eventTypes.name: Shot block

eventTypes.name: Pressure
eventTypes.definition: Reduce the puck carrier time or options through proximity and positioning. Record consequence separately; pressure need not produce a takeaway.

eventTypes.name: Stick check
eventTypes.definition: Use the stick to challenge the puck or restrict an option. A successful contact need not establish possession.

eventTypes.name: Body check
eventTypes.definition: Apply body contact to challenge an eligible opponent under the competition rules. Contact is not inherently positive; record checking rules and consequence.

eventTypes.name: Gap control
eventTypes.definition: Assess defender distance, angle and speed relative to the attacker at the marked moment. Specify the observed issue in context.

eventTypes.name: Coverage
eventTypes.definition: Assess assignment, positioning and lane protection at the marked moment. Do not infer a breakdown cause without evidence.

categories.description: Discrete defensive actions and technical observations; consequences can be linked to the same play.

categories.name: Team Play

eventTypes.name: Breakout
eventTypes.definition: Sequence-level observation of recovery, support and puck movement out of the defensive zone. Not an additional discrete zone-exit attempt.

eventTypes.name: Zone Entry
eventTypes.definition: Legacy zone-entry observation; method and possession outcome unspecified.

eventTypes.name: Regroup
eventTypes.definition: Controlled team reorganization before another attack, usually in the neutral zone. A backward pass alone is not a regroup.

eventTypes.name: Forecheck
eventTypes.definition: Coaching observation of coordinated pressure on an opponent breakout. Individual pressure/takeaway records may link to the same sequence.

eventTypes.name: Face Off
eventTypes.definition: Legacy faceoff observation; win/loss outcome unspecified.

eventTypes.name: Backcheck
eventTypes.definition: Team or player recovery pressure toward the defensive zone; assess positioning and assignment at the marked moment.

eventTypes.name: Cycle
eventTypes.definition: Coordinated possession rotation in the offensive zone. A sequence observation, not a new pass count.

eventTypes.name: Support / outlet

eventTypes.name: Screen

eventTypes.name: Net drive

categories.description: Tactical observations and sequences; do not sum these with discrete action totals.

categories.name: Faceoffs

eventTypes.name: Won
eventTypes.definition: Our team establishes controlled possession following the draw. Timestamp control; this is team outcome, not individual center credit.

eventTypes.name: Lost
eventTypes.definition: Opponent establishes controlled possession following the draw. Timestamp control; do not infer individual blame.

eventTypes.name: Undetermined
eventTypes.definition: The draw occurs but resulting team control cannot be established.

categories.description: Resolve a legal draw by team controlled possession under this coding protocol.

categories.name: Goalie

eventTypes.name: Goal Against
eventTypes.definition: Awarded goal conceded by the observed goalie/team. Timestamp shot release. This result does not establish goalie error.

eventTypes.name: Save
eventTypes.definition: The goalie prevents an on-target shot from scoring. Timestamp shot release and link the shot incident; assess rebound disposition separately.

eventTypes.name: Rebound Control
eventTypes.definition: Legacy rebound-control assessment; rebound disposition unspecified. Preserve the recorded grade.

eventTypes.name: Puck Play
eventTypes.definition: Goalie handles the puck outside a save: stop a rim, pass, clear, or set the puck. Record action outcome when observed.

eventTypes.name: Positioning
eventTypes.definition: Coaching observation of goalie angle, depth, set position, or recovery at the marked instant. Grade only what the view supports.

categories.description: Goalie observations linked to the originating shot where applicable. Outcomes do not imply execution quality.

categories.name: Penalty

eventTypes.name: Our penalty
eventTypes.definition: Penalty assessed to the analysis team. Record the assessed infraction and duration if known; do not infer either from grade.

eventTypes.name: Opponent penalty
eventTypes.definition: Penalty assessed to the opponent. Do not infer which player drew it, or that it was drawn by a player.

eventTypes.name: Coincidental penalties
eventTypes.definition: Linked penalties assessed to both teams on the same incident. Preserve separate assessments in linked notes/events; do not infer strength state.

categories.description: Assessed penalties attributed to the reference team; retain individual assessments for coincidental penalties.

categories.name: Stoppages

eventTypes.name: Icing
eventTypes.definition: Icing called under the competition rules. Attribute offending side if known; do not infer a pass attempt or turnover.

eventTypes.name: Offside
eventTypes.definition: Offside called under the competition rules. Link the entry attempt if known.

eventTypes.name: Puck out of play
eventTypes.definition: Play stops because the puck leaves the playing area. Do not infer delay-of-game without an assessed penalty.

eventTypes.name: Puck covered / frozen
eventTypes.definition: Play stops because the puck is covered or frozen. Link a goalie save when applicable; not an extra shot.

eventTypes.name: Other whistle
eventTypes.definition: Other observable stoppage. Describe the reason in notes; leave unknown when the footage does not establish it.

categories.description: Whistles and stoppages linked to an action if known. Not automatically turnovers or negative grades.
